description: Property: unparsing a tree and re-parsing it must return the same tree, verified by Hypothesis with generated ASTs.

steps.description: Round-trip test with Hypothesis given decorator.
Imports: parse from your parser, unparse from your AST nodes.
Test function: given generates exprs, each must satisfy parse(unparse(tree)) == tree.
Assertion: structural equality checks whole tree identity.
